incoming.name: Diamond simulant
incoming.excerpt: The use of hardness points and scratch plates made of corundum (hardness 9) are also used in place of glass.

outgoing.name: Crystal
outgoing.excerpt: Corundum (from Tamil kurundam) is a crystalline form of aluminium oxide and one of the rock-forming minerals.

outgoing.name: Greece
outgoing.excerpt: Emery grade corundum is found on the Greek island of Naxos and near Peekskill, New York.

outgoing.name: Russia
outgoing.excerpt: Corundum for abrasives is mined in Zimbabwe, Russia, and India.
